stem_book: Find the frictional force on the block and its direction (in newton). A block of mass m = 3 kg rests on a fixed incline of 30°; the coefficient of friction is μ = 0.58. (Take g = 10 m/s²)
reason: Print reads 'Take N = 3kg' — misprint for m = 3 kg, corrected.
work: mg sin30 = 15 N < μ mg cos30 = 0.58·25.98 = 15.07 N → static, f = 15 N up the incline
